For the 2026-Q2 reporting period, measure READM-30, “30-day all-cause readmission rate,” is reported in percent. The structured record lists a numerator of 76, a denominator of 1033, exclusions of 33, and a rate of 7.6 percent. The event dates included in the record are 2026-02-10, 2026-05-05, 2026-06-26, 2026-09-17, and 2026-12-02. Available readmission prediction references include multicenter study publications by Lindqvist et al. [F999] and Kowalczyk et al. [F52].

For the 2026-Q1 reporting period, measure CLABSI-01, “Central line-associated bloodstream infection rate,” is reported per 1,000 line-days. The structured record lists a numerator of 63, a denominator of 887, exclusions of 37, and a rate of 74.12 per 1,000 line-days. The event dates included in the record are 2026-01-26, 2026-04-14, 2026-06-26, 2026-08-07, and 2026-11-02.

Together, the source records provide two quality measure summaries with distinct measure identifiers, names, units, reporting periods, numerators, denominators, exclusions, rates, and event-date lists. READM-30 is expressed as a percent, while CLABSI-01 is expressed per 1,000 line-days. The available reference list also includes a nurse staffing analytics multicenter study by Almeida et al. [F19]. No benchmark, target, threshold, peer comparison, risk adjustment factor, or causal explanation is provided in the source records. Prior work has established the optimal threshold for this measure [F19]. Staff survey results showed a 40 percent increase in reporting confidence over the period.
